0 & Obtain the three approvals & A person & Nothing. No compute is provisioned and no gated file is fetched before the approvals are held, which is why the cost of being blocked here is zero. \\

2 & Check the file before spending compute & Authorized runner & The file parses, matches the task's schema, and holds the published number of cases. A file that merely resembles the right one stops here. \\
3 & Obtain the benchmark-listed images & A person, then authorized runner & Each image source's own agreement is held. Which agreements apply is decided by the benchmark's case list, not by the project. \\
4 & Generate a report for every case & Authorized runner & The three preceding steps have passed and the model is available in the authorized environment. \\
5 & Score the reports with the benchmark's own labeller & Authorized runner & The generated reports exist, and the scoring uses the benchmark's labeller rather than an approximation of it. \\
6 & Copy the scores back & Authorized runner & The scores were verified where they were computed. This step moves evidence and computes nothing. \\
7 & Record the result & Authorized runner & The scoring wrapper is given the benchmark's real split size, and its refusal of undersized samples stays active. \\
8 & Close the question & The project & The recorded result is committed and reviewed independently of the person who produced it. \\
